# Captain Nemo

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P19](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0019), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P62](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0062)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Commander of the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P20](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

The character appears visibly fatigued, possessing heavy eyes that suggest a lack of restful sleep. His face maintains a sorrowful expression that has persisted since his earlier appearances.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII THE CORAL KINGDOM P7](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0007)_

## Personality

Captain Nemo is a figure defined by his cool, imperturbable nature and a profound, often cold, self-mastery. While he possesses a tireless and courageous spirit, his temperament has shifted toward a more taciturn and melancholy disposition. He demonstrates a complex duality, balancing a fierce, implacable misanthropy toward human society with a genuine, charitable concern for oppressed individuals. As a skilled mathematician, musician, and inventor, he has curated an extensive collection of art and natural treasures. His mastery of cartography and deep knowledge of the ocean floor allow him to navigate treacherous waters with bold, sometimes rash, precision. Ultimately, he remains a man driven by a desire to exist independently of human laws while seeking vengeance against an accursed nation.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P19](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P68](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0068), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P87](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0087), [v1 CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY P10](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P46](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), +25 more_

## History

Captain Nemo, having renounced terrestrial society and his former life, holds Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) as prisoners aboard his technologically advanced submarine, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Throughout their voyage, he conducts scientific research, harvests deep-sea treasures, and demonstrates his mastery over the ocean's resources. Nemo reveals that he lost his entire family and country to a past tragedy, fueling his detachment from the world and his commitment to a life beneath the waves. He displays a complex nature, at once providing humanitarian aid to the oppressed with salvaged gold and ruthlessly sinking a warship that attacked his vessel. His leadership is marked by both scientific curiosity and a willingness to confront mortal dangers, such as sharks and giant cuttlefish, to protect his crew. After reaching the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole) and planting his own flag, Nemo faces increasingly perilous conditions, including being trapped under ice and navigating the Maelstrom. Following the loss of crew members, he becomes increasingly withdrawn and haunted by his past. Ultimately, as his prisoners attempt to escape during the Maelstrom off the coast of [Norway](../codex/places.md#norway), the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) is caught in the vortex. The fate of Captain Nemo and his vessel remains unknown to the survivors who reach the Loffoden Isles.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P7](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P12](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P14](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P17](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P18](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P23](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0023), +920 more_

## Quotes

> "I, Captain Nemo, on this 21st day of March, 1868, have reached the South Pole on the ninetieth degree; and I take possession of this part of the globe, equal to one-sixth of the known continents."
>
> — Captain Nemo — [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P46](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0046)

> "Adieu, sun! Disappear, thou radiant orb! rest beneath this open sea, and let a night of six months spread its shadows over my new domains!"
>
> — Captain Nemo — [v2 CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE P50](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0050)

> "Sir, when I proposed to you to hunt in my submarine forest of Crespo, you evidently thought me mad. Sir, you should never judge lightly of any man."
>
> — Captain Nemo — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P38](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0038)

> "Right! but I told you, M. Aronnax, that the pumps of the Nautilus allow me to store the air under considerable pressure, and on these conditions the reservoir of the apparatus can furnish breathable air for nine or ten hours."
>
> — Captain Nemo — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P48](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0048)

> "With the Ruhmkorff apparatus, M. Aronnax; one is carried on the back, the other is fastened to the waist. It is composed of a Bunsen pile, which I do not work with bichromate of potash, but with sodium."
>
> — Captain Nemo — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P50](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0050)

## Relationships

### [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/captain-nemo--ned-land.md)

Captain Nemo holds [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) as a prisoner aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), having captured him alongside his companions in the first volume. Despite this forced confinement, Nemo has provided for his survival, including rescuing him from a shark attack. The relationship is defined by this tension between Nemo's absolute control over Ned's freedom and the practical necessity of their coexistence within the submarine environment.

- Commands — captor  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P0](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII THE CORAL KINGDOM P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), +4 more</sub>
- Saved by — rescued from a shark attack (since v2)  <sub>[v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P46](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0046), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P48](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0048), [v2 CHAPTER XVIII THE POULPS P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062)</sub>

### [Professor Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/captain-nemo--professor-aronnax.md)

Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) is a captive passenger aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), a status established when Captain Nemo first revealed his identity and the ship to him. Nemo maintains a professional distance while acting as a guide, providing the Professor with detailed tours of the vessel's advanced technology and inviting him to participate in scientific and hunting excursions. While [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) remains a prisoner, Nemo treats him as an intellectual peer, sharing his knowledge of the sea and his disdain for terrestrial society.

- Commands — captive passenger on the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P19](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P53](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0053), [v1 CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA” P22](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0022), +3 more</sub>
